ModMetaData.name: Remote Doors
ModMetaData.author: roman_gr
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the remote door: a powered door that is held open for as long as it receives electricity, and closes itself the moment power is cut.
Wire a set of remote doors to their own conduit branch behind a power switch and you can open or seal a whole route by flicking that one switch. Handy for opening a path into a killbox only when you want it open.
With no power the remote door behaves exactly like an ordinary door - colonists can still open it by hand, just more slowly. Power loss, a solar flare or a breakdown all leave it closed rather than stuck open.
Unlocked by the autodoor research.
